name: physical-ai-bench-artifacts
description: A dataset of physical artifacts collected for evaluating perception and robustness of embodied/robotic vision systems in real-world settings. It provides images and metadata of common physical artifacts to test detection, classification, and generalization under varying conditions. Benchmarks using this dataset measure model robustness to real-world appearance changes and domain shifts.
reputation: A small, specialized Hugging Face dataset used by a niche community researching physical-world artifacts and sim-to-real robustness.
